scope: API public ledger read rejects expired responses/errors and decoding results using wall and monotonic time, even without timer dispatch.
coverage: Three clock configurations: forward wall time, monotonic expiry, monotonic expiry with backwards wall time. Each exercises response, null and rejection beyond the deadline without dispatching timers.
Decoder returns or throws after crossing the monotonic deadline.
Existing timer timeout, late response ignored, explicit fresh retry, timely absent-state and provider-error behavior remain covered.
limits: Provider and decoder are mocked in public-state tests; no physical suspend or live indexer validation.
Already-running query/decode work is not cancelled. Synchronous decoding can still block until it returns; expired results are rejected afterward.
No new E2E/full workspace run, container image, security scan, native-wallet transaction or public deployment.
